A few days ago, my wife's Samsung Galaxy F62 suddenly stopped working and was found in an off condition. Naturally, I took the device to a nearby repair shop called "S K Mobile And Repairing Centre" this shop for assistance. Here is where my ordeal began.

After their assessment, they revealed that the so-called repair carried out by the previous individual was nothing more than a sham. They confirmed that the IC was never replaced.
The most shocking part was when I asked the initial repair person to return the graphics IC that he claimed to have replaced. He callously responded that it had been thrown away, further raising doubts about his dishonest practices.
Eventually, I got my mobile phone genuinely repaired from the new shop at a much lower cost & it worked fine.
I am sharing this incident to raise awareness about this dishonest mobile repair shop. It is unfortunate that some unscrupulous individuals are taking advantage of innocent customers and looting them for subpar services.
